d: We are looking for a strategic, relationship-driven, and commercially oriented International Partnership Manager to identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships across international markets.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building relationships with global organizations, distributors, business associates, and strategic stakeholders to create new business opportunities, strengthen international market presence, and drive sustainable organizational growth.

This role requires strong business development capabilities, negotiation skills, international market knowledge, and the ability to establish mutually beneficial partnerships across different geographical regions.
Develop and execute international partnership strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Identify, research, and evaluate potential international partners, distributors, agents, and strategic alliances.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with overseas organizations, corporate clients, and business stakeholders.
Identify new partnership opportunities to support international market expansion and business development.
Lead partnership negotiations, commercial discussions, and agreement development with international stakeholders.
Develop strategic proposals, partnership models, and business collaboration frameworks.
Evaluate potential partners based on market presence, business capabilities, commercial value, and strategic alignment.
Manage the complete partnership lifecycle, from partner identification and onboarding to relationship development and performance evaluation.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, finance, legal, and operations teams to execute partnership initiatives.
Monitor partnership performance, business contributions, revenue opportunities, and strategic objectives.
Conduct international market research and competitor analysis to identify potential collaboration opportunities.
Explore opportunities for joint ventures, distribution agreements, licensing arrangements, and strategic collaborations.
Ensure partnership agreements align with organizational policies, commercial objectives, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Resolve partnership-related challenges and maintain effective communication with international stakeholders.
Represent the organization at international business meetings, trade exhibitions, conferences, and networking events.
Prepare partnership performance reports, market assessments, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
4–7 years of relevant experience in International Partnerships, Strategic Alliances, Business Development, or Relationship Management.
Proven experience developing and managing international business relationships.
Strong understanding of global markets, international business practices, and strategic partnership development.

q: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline, with 5-8 years of experience in commissioning, servicing, and troubleshooting Automatic Voltage Regulators (AVR), Static Excitation Equipment (SEE), and Generator Protection Relay systems within the power generation industry.
Professional certifications such as Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) Accreditation and OEM Certification in AVR/SEE Systems are highly desirable.

Strong technical expertise in AVR, SEE, generator excitation systems, generator protection relays, electrical control systems, parameterization/configuration, and gas turbine power generation technologies.

Proven experience in protection relay commissioning, advanced diagnostics, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), troubleshooting, signal analysis, control loop tuning, and resolving complex excitation and generator protection system failures in live operating environments.

Demonstrated ability to prepare technical documentation, provide customer-facing technical support, ensure HSE compliance, and successfully execute large-scale power generation projects across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East region.
r: Your day involves leading the commissioning, testing, and integration of AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) and Static Excitation Equipment (SEE) systems for heavy-duty gas turbine power plants, ensuring reliable generator performance and grid compliance. You diagnose complex excitation and electrical control issues, provide expert technical guidance on-site, and work closely with commissioning and service teams to optimize plant reliability and minimize operational risks.
Lead the commissioning, testing, configuration, and integration of Automatic Voltage Regulators (AVR) and Static Excitation Equipment (SEE) for heavy-duty gas turbine power plants.
Perform site assessments, functional testing, and system validation to ensure excitation systems operate safely and in compliance with Siemens Energy standards.
Analyze, tune, and optimize excitation control loops and system performance during plant startup and commissioning activities.
Conduct advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and fact-finding investigations for AVR/SEE failures and electrical system abnormalities, implementing effective corrective actions.

Provide technical support, customer training, and detailed commissioning and technical reports while collaborating with global engineering teams to resolve complex site issues and enhance plant reliability.

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh , a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ 125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

Join Socket to build and scale our patching infrastructure that delivers secure, vetted packages to developers worldwide. You’ll be at the forefront of supply chain security, creating patches for critical vulnerabilities and building the systems that help the entire open source ecosystem stay secure.

This role combines deep technical work with meaningful community impact that benefits the entire ecosystem. As an early member of the Socket team, you’ll help shape how we scale this technology across the JavaScript ecosystem and beyond.
